name: Med Spas & Wellness
title: Referral Partners for Med Spas | Our Local Network
description: We visit the gyms, salons and studios near your med spa in Oak Brook, Hinsdale and Naperville. You see every visit and every sign-up in your portal.
cardBlurb: We visit the gyms, salons and studios your clients already go to.
intro: We find businesses near your med spa that share your clients. Every month we visit them and introduce your med spa by name.
partnersIntro: Your clients already spend time at these places, and the staff see them often.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Their members already put time and money into how they look and feel.

partners.name: Yoga and pilates studios
partners.why: Regulars come back every week, and the front desk knows them by name.

partners.name: Hair salons
partners.why: Clients talk with their stylist about how they want to look.

partners.name: Nail salons
partners.why: Regulars come in every few weeks and know the staff well.

partners.name: Bridal shops
partners.why: Brides and their families want to look their best on the big day.

partners.name: Clothing boutiques
partners.why: Shoppers care about how they look and like to shop close to home.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for everyone on shift, from the front desk to the stylists.
treatExamples: Coffee and pastries for a hair salon's morning stylists
Muffins and coffee for a gym's opening front desk crew
Cookies and iced coffee for a nail salon's afternoon shift
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal, and your front desk makes the call, not us.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: You and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per patient.

notes.title: No patient records, ever
notes.text: We never receive patient records, and partners never see who signed up. The sign-up form asks no health questions.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We make no medical or health claims. We describe your services only in words you approve.

exclusivity: Each partner agrees to promote one med spa, yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Can't I just walk into the gym next door myself?
faq.a: You can. The hard part is finding the right businesses, visiting every month and tracking every sign-up.

faq.q: What about the rules for healthcare practices?
faq.a: Partner programs for healthcare practices are reviewed for compliance with applicable state rules before launch. If your lawyer wants to read the partner agreement, we'll send it.

faq.q: What if a business on the list feels too close to mine?
faq.a: Take it off the list. We only visit the businesses you approve.

aboutText: I'm asking about referral partners for my med spa.
